comparisons.peer_summary: AMD's operating results vary seasonally, with historically higher net revenue in the second half of the year compared to the first half, although these trends may be impacted by market conditions and product transitions.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose that their hardware revenues exhibit seasonal trends favoring the second half of the fiscal year. NVIDIA specifically attributes this seasonality to its desktop gaming products, noting that they 'typically see stronger revenue in the second half of our fiscal year' and cautioning that 'historical seasonality trends may not repeat.' AMD provides a broader disclosure on its operating results, stating that 'net revenue has been generally higher in the second half of the year than in the first half of the year,' while also noting that 'market conditions and product transitions could impact these trends.' While NVIDIA isolates the seasonality to a specific product line (desktop gaming), AMD describes the seasonality across its broader operating results, though both highlight the risk that historical patterns may not persist.
